name: Persistent Memory Storage
what_it_does: Stores interaction context across sessions using local plain-text markdown files.

name: Voice Interface (Backtalk)
what_it_does: Provides real-time speech input and output audio feedback using Claude SDK.

name: Visualizer Circuit HUD
what_it_does: Displays system state (Listening, Thinking, Speaking) using animated HUD graphics.

name: Bare Hands Gesture Control
what_it_does: Allows spatial manipulation of 3D objects, images, and text windows via webcam gesture tracking.

name: Local File and Tool Execution
what_it_does: Reads, writes, and executes shell commands and scripts directly on host machine.
